title: Vampire Vape Tropical Kiwi Cooler 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Kiwi Cooler 100ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection is a citrusy, refreshing blend of Golden Kiwi and Tangelo with a soft, cooling finish. The Golden Kiwi lends tropical sweetness with a smooth, mellow edge, while Tangelo introduces zesty citrus with a tart, slightly floral note. A light chill ties the profile together, creating a smooth and refreshing DTL vape. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this shortfill is perfect for sub-ohm kits and high-wattage direct-to-lung (DTL) devices. Add two 10ml nicotine shots to reach your preferred strength. Vampire Vape e-liquids are crafted in the UK and offer bold, reliable flavour. The Tropical collection brings light, vibrant fruit blends into focus. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Concentrate formats.
